title: Partially observable non-occurrence
purpose: Expose reduced opportunity coverage rather than hiding it.

expected.semantic_interpretation: The model can carry a non-occurrence claim together with explicitly partial opportunity observability.
expected.observability: Coverage is partial and must remain visible to later logic.
expected.opportunity: Opportunity observability is PARTIAL, preventing a false claim of complete coverage.
expected.time: Phenomenon, observation/result, and ingestion times remain distinct fields.
expected.provenance: Source identity and capture/procedure provenance remain explicit.
expected.raw_derived: Evidence kind is explicit and does not imply a pattern.
expected.lineage: No correction, deletion, or supersession is asserted.
expected.must_not_infer: Do not infer a routine, preference, habit, or pattern conclusion.
